reasoning_content: The local environment doesn't have the repo. Let me use paramiko to connect to the VPS and do the git operations there.

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
import os
os.environ['GITHUB_TOKEN'] = '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'
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Update remote with token
c.exec_command("""cd /opt/areloria
git remote set-url origin https://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@github.com/OuroborosCollective/Wasd.git
git add -A
git commit -m 'Monorepo: Add core-network package, client-2d PixiJS app, shared network layer' || echo 'Nothing to commit'""")

# Push to main
c.exec_command("""cd /opt/areloria
git push origin main 2>&1 || echo 'Push failed'""")

print("Done!")

c.close()
EOF
